name: invokeai
description: A Model Context Protocol server for InvokeAI image generation, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, LoRA models, SDXL, VAE overrides, and AI upscaling

optional.name: INVOKEAI_BASE_URL
optional.description: Base URL for InvokeAI API (default: http://127.0.0.1:9090)

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate images from text prompts with optional LoRA support and VAE override

tools.name: img2img
tools.description: Transform existing images using text guidance with optional LoRA support and VAE override

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale images to higher resolution using AI

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available models (main, LoRA, VAE, upscaling)

external.name: InvokeAI
external.description: InvokeAI v4.0+ running locally or remotely
